# Operis

> Operis is an open, high-trust, zero-commission freelance software engineering directory and bilateral matching network operated by Vellium, headquartered in Istanbul, Turkey.

Operis eliminates traditional marketplace broker fees, platform escrow holds, bidding race-to-the-bottom undercutting, and communication restrictions. It serves verified software engineers, technical leads, and innovative technology companies.

## Core Architectural Pillars & Philosophy

- **0% Platform Commission**: Operis never charges a percentage cut, matching tax, or extraction fee on projects. 100% of agreed compensation goes directly from employer to engineer.
- **168-Hour Freshness Radar**: All project listings remain active on the platform for strictly 168 hours (7 days) before automatic archival unless refreshed by the author. Ghost postings and stale listings are eliminated.
- **AES-256 Encrypted Blind Bidding**: Proposal text, rates, and milestone timelines are encrypted at rest with military-grade AES-256-GCM. Competitors cannot inspect bids or undercut prices.
- **Direct Bilateral Collaboration**: Once a proposal is accepted, verified phone, email, WhatsApp, and Slack channels unlock immediately. Operis enforces zero platform gag orders.
- **Statutory IP & Contract Compliance**: Full compliance with Turkish Copyright Law (5846 sayılı FSEK m. 52), Code of Obligations (TBK), electronic self-employment receipts (e-SMM), and intermediary hosting provider status (5651 sayılı Kanun).

- [Corporate Manifesto & About Us](https://operis.pro/tr/hakkimizda): Philosophical pillars, comparison matrix, and corporate governance.

## Technical Architecture & Security Model

- Built on Next.js 15 App Router, React 19, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
- PostgreSQL database with strict Row Level Security (RLS) policies and Drizzle ORM.
- Cloudflare Edge CDN, DDoS mitigation, and fail-open Turnstile human verification.
- Zero-Escrow Architecture: Operis never holds custody of user deposits, eliminating insolvency, fund seizure, or withdrawal lock risks.

## Corporate & Statutory Identity

- **Platform Operator**: Vellium (Vellium Teknolojileri ve İnovasyon)
- **Headquarters**: İstanbul, Turkey (TR-34, 34394)
- **Jurisdiction**: Republic of Turkey
- **Statutory Role**: Law No. 5651 Intermediary Service Provider (Yer Sağlayıcı)
- **Official Inquiries**: KEP & UETS electronic notice registered
